summary: Full-size, first-party reviewed product face inside the authenticated Dual wallet. Uses the existing dual.face.bridge v1 envelope, handshake and limits; adds a programme ('application') context variant and named capability modules. No second postMessage protocol, no generic fetch/proxy/token operation.

contextVariants.application: new; sent ONLY to a product-application binding; object_id and object are null

applicationBinding.source: wallet server-only registry PRODUCT_FACE_APPLICATIONS (JSON array); resolved by an authenticated wallet BFF route, never from face, object custom data or URL

fields.origin: exact https origin (http only for loopback outside production)
fields.artifactHash: sha256:<64 hex> of the emitted artifact manifest
fields.templateIds: Dual template ids (24 hex) that belong to the programme
fields.projectionFields: public custom fields the host may project to the face, subset of [recordId,title,serialNumber,model,manufacturer,state]

applicationBinding.readyIdentity: dual.face.ready.application must be {id, version, publisher, programme, artifact, contract:'dual-product-face-v1'} and EVERY value must equal the binding exactly (version exact, not just major); mismatch closes the channel

taskPath.rule: a path segment that names a product is a hint only; the host re-selects through programme.product.select

programme.products.list.authority: wallet BFF -> api-v3 listObjects for the session wallet, filtered to binding.templateIds; server authorises person and resource

programme.product.select.authority: host re-reads getObjectById; must be owned by the session wallet AND in binding.templateIds; otherwise not_in_programme / not_owned; replaces any previous selection and invalidates its context_id

navigation.task.update.effect: host mirrors to wallet URL (push for new task, replace when same); Back/Forward and reload restore it

payload.object_id: 24 hex (Dual object of the exact unit, resolved by the runtime from handover evidence)

result.assertion: one-time wallet assertion (scope register, bound to op + object + audience)

programme.registration.authorize.authority: host reads the PUBLIC object projection, requires template in binding.templateIds and owner != session wallet; shows NATIVE confirmation with canonical facts (name, serial/model from public projection, programme, publisher, the user's own wallet); persists the operation OUTSIDE the iframe BEFORE issuing the assertion; never accepts a recipient/wallet from the face
errors: operation_already_submitted (no re-mint for an issued operation)

result.readback: host canonical readback: owner == session wallet

programme.operation.status.authority: read-only; reconciles from the host journal + api-v3 readback; never retries or re-mints

payload.request_hash: sha256:<hex> of the canonical JSON runtime request body (excluding assertion)

result.assertion: one-time wallet assertion bound to exactly this operation/target/request

programme.runtime.authorize.authority: host requires the selected product context for product targets; read operations need no dialog; WRITE operations (case.open, case.evidence.submit, case.information.provide, case.quote.approve, case.quote.decline) require NATIVE host confirmation naming the application, programme, operation kind from host vocabulary and the canonical product; publisher-provided summaries are labelled as such; quote approval states no payment is taken

session.ended.rule: host then closes the channel and removes the frame; face must drop all private state

registrationRules: Register product is the reviewed Passport first-owner handoff: owner-link grant (handover evidence) + request_transfer with the requester own verified wallet (from the wallet assertion, never from the client) + issuer-signed Dual transfer + exact readback.

NEVER map Register product to the Dual standard action claim_ownership (that claims an object ON CHAIN as a collectible; it is not holder ownership). Neither host nor face may request claim_ownership for registration. Regression-tested in both repos.
A serial number, login, bookmark, object id, task link or owner equality ALONE is not registration.

registered requires ALL of: (a) runtime verified first_owner_handoff readback with passportCanonicalState status agrees; (b) host api-v3 readback owner == session wallet account address; (c) Dual custom.state in canonicalRegistration.settledStates; (d) custom.lifecycle.target_state absent or equal to custom.state.

owner == wallet but custom.state == Transfer pending (passport canonical status ownership_moved_dual_state_pending) => ownership_moved_state_pending: shown as NOT yet registered/unconfirmed until properly settled. Negative regression required in both repos.
owner == wallet but state in endedStates or disagreeing lifecycle target => recovery_required, never registered.

Cancellation before the assertion is issued = not_submitted. After issue, a lost frame/confirmation/reload is outcome_unknown until read-only reconciliation; the original operation is retained; no blind retry, remint or replacement.
Unknown counters are null, never inferred zero.

walletAssertion.format: compact JWS, alg EdDSA (Ed25519), typ dual-face-assertion+jwt
walletAssertion.issuer: wallet BFF only (server-only FACE_ASSERTION_SIGNING_KEY + FACE_ASSERTION_KEY_ID); absent/invalid key => 503 face_assertion_unprovisioned (fail closed); minted only while the wallet session is active and only for a server-resolved binding
claims: holder (session wallet account address, read server-side; never from the face)
walletAssertion.verifier: Studio runtime only; keys TIG_PRODUCT_FACE_WALLET_ASSERTION_KEYS (JSON {kid: spki PEM}), issuers TIG_PRODUCT_FACE_WALLET_ISSUERS (exact origins); checks alg/typ/kid/signature, iss, aud == own applicationId@origin, app_version/publisher/programme == served artifact, operation == endpoint, target == request target, request_hash == hash(body), exp/iat skew <= 60s, then consumes jti atomically ONCE (durable store) before any read or write; any failure refuses with zero writes
walletAssertion.noFaceSession: There is NO runtime face session, cookie or bearer. Every runtime operation (read or write) needs its own fresh one-time assertion, so after host logout/expiry/account change no new authority can be minted. Residual: at most one unconsumed assertion, single exact op/target/request, <= 60s. Zero-residual revocation needs a wallet-side introspection/revocation contract (named requirement).
walletAssertion.gap: G1: no canonical Dual/api-v3 launch or identity contract exists for a wallet person to reach a Studio runtime. This assertion is the secure seam. Provisioning (keys, issuers, audiences) is separate and stays fail-closed.

runtime.framing: CSP frame-ancestors = exact configured wallet origins (TIG_PRODUCT_FACE_WALLET_ORIGINS); no X-Frame-Options DENY on this route only; every other route unchanged

result.accounting: {providerWritesExecuted, dualWritesExecuted, readbacksExecuted, unknownWriteOutcomes} integer or null

POST /api/product-face/v1/registrations/.result: read-only reconcile of the durable intent/outbox; same shape as registrations

POST /api/product-face/v1/operations.result: operation-specific; every response carries status, writesExecuted, dualWritesExecuted (integer or null), unknownWriteOutcomes (integer or null), secretReturned:false

localHarness.walletE2eFaceFixture: http://localhost:4101 (pinned emitted Studio artifact + labelled fake runtime, wallet e2e only)
localHarness.studioFaceRuntime: http://localhost:4180 (actual Studio runtime + emitted artifact, scripts/product-face-harness.mjs)
localHarness.studioFakeDual: http://127.0.0.1:4011 (Studio local fake Dual, labelled; serves api-v3 shaped GET /objects/:id, GET /objects?template_id=&owner=, GET /ebus/action-logs?object_id= for programme objects)
localHarness.integratedMode: wallet mock-api forwards programme-template object reads to MOCK_PROGRAMME_DUAL_URL=http://127.0.0.1:4011 so both sides read one fake Dual state

knownGaps.G1: wallet->runtime person identity/launch contract (assertion seam above; provisioning required)
knownGaps.G2: generated apps send frame-ancestors 'none' and SameSite=Strict cookies; the face uses its own versioned framable route and an in-memory face handle, not role-session cookies
knownGaps.G3: Claims pack lacks information-request and quote approve/decline. IN SCOPE: second Studio increment adds them additively (new pack revision, new transitions/roles/canonical mappings; old grants keep their exact permittedActionIds and gain nothing; closed != repaired; quote approval captures no payment; documented migration).
knownGaps.G4: Passport model content has no setup/troubleshooting/manual fields; supplied as versioned face content
knownGaps.G5: no backend face-application registry; wallet uses a deployment-configured server-only registry
knownGaps.G6: Settling ownership_moved_dual_state_pending needs the holder to sign the brand-proposed verify_authenticity; the wallet executor has no reviewed path for that purpose action yet, so the face shows it as unconfirmed with the next step.

runtimeOperations.products.private.read: read; private Passport facts/documents for an owned product
runtimeOperations.cases.list: read; the holder own cases for the selected product
runtimeOperations.case.information.provide: write; NEW customer response to a reviewer information request (G3 increment)
runtimeOperations.case.quote.approve: write; NEW customer approval of a service quote, no payment capture (G3 increment)
